meta.note: Primitives hold raw values. Semantic tokens are named by intent and reference primitives. Component tokens reference semantic tokens. Do not skip layers.

brand._note: Brand color families — primary and secondary. Figma: color/primitive/brand/*.

stpatrick._note: Brand primary palette. Figma: color/primitive/brand/stpatrick/*. Confirmed: REST API node 658:2055 (stpatrick/800=#20184B), alpha/stpatrick/16=#513ebe29.

skableoff._note: Brand secondary palette. Figma: color/primitive/brand/skableoff/*. User-confirmed Figma family name.

devil._note: Status danger/error palette. Figma: color/primitive/devil/*. Confirmed: alpha/devil/16=#ea343429 (base #ea3434=devil/200).

gold._note: Status warning palette. Figma: color/primitive/gold/*. User-confirmed Figma family name.

electric._note: Status info palette. Figma: color/primitive/electric/*. User-confirmed Figma family name.

avocado._note: Status success palette. Figma: color/primitive/avocado/*. User-confirmed Figma family name.

alpha._note: Alpha color tokens. Figma: color/alpha/*. Naming: {family}{opacity-percent}. Values confirmed via Figma REST API.

_legacy._note: LEGACY alpha names — do not use in new tokens. Stale/incorrect values preserved for reference only.
LEGACY primitive color families — original generic names. Superseded by canonical Figma-native names above. Kept for backward compat; do not add new references.

purple._legacyNote: LEGACY — superseded by canonical Figma-native name. All semantic and component refs have been migrated. Kept as alias; do not add new references.

teal._legacyNote: LEGACY — superseded by canonical Figma-native name. All semantic and component refs have been migrated. Kept as alias; do not add new references.

red._legacyNote: LEGACY — superseded by canonical Figma-native name. All semantic and component refs have been migrated. Kept as alias; do not add new references.

yellow._legacyNote: LEGACY — superseded by canonical Figma-native name. All semantic and component refs have been migrated. Kept as alias; do not add new references.

blue._legacyNote: LEGACY — superseded by canonical Figma-native name. All semantic and component refs have been migrated. Kept as alias; do not add new references.

green._legacyNote: LEGACY — superseded by canonical Figma-native name. All semantic and component refs have been migrated. Kept as alias; do not add new references.

medium._note: Figma: h3/medium. Open Sans has no native 500 weight — resolves to Regular/400 in browser.
Figma: body/medium/*. Open Sans has no native 500 weight — resolves to SemiBold/600 in browser. Identical rendered output to body/semiBold.

buttonGlow._note: CSS emission names this group --shadow-glow-* (the 'button' prefix is dropped). e.g. buttonGlow.brandPrimary → --shadow-glow-brand-primary. This is an emission naming convention; values are unchanged.

components._note: Captured from Figma Effect Styles. Not yet usage-audited. Do not bind to components until component-level audit.

overlay._note: Overlay/backdrop tokens. Figma: overlay/* theme collection (VariableID:2467:25474). Sync: 2026-08-25.

chart._note: Chart data visualization palette. Series 1–8 + Up/Down + empty. Dark mode inverts the scale: lighter↔darker, light↔dark, default shifts to .400. Primitive source: primitive.color.chart.*. Tooltip tokens are deferred — Tooltip is a separate component and will be handled in its own handoff/audit.

alert._note: 5 statuses × 4 styles = 20 combos × 4 roles (bg/border/icon/text) = 80 slots. CSS: tokens.css --alert-{status}-{style}-{role}. Light refs primitive directly; dark inverts the scale (filled: bg/border shift from .600→.100, icon/text from white→slate.900). Status maps: danger=error, info=information.

accordion._note: CSS impl: tokens.css --accordion-* (light). Dark mode auto-flips via semantic cascade — no dark overrides needed. icon.soft uses semantic.color.icon.soft (not color.text.subtle) to resolve correctly in dark (#989dae = slate.400).

button._note: CSS impl: tokens.css --button-* (light) + [data-theme='dark'] overrides. Button.css uses --button-{variant}-{type}-* vars. Paths follow semantic → component layering; primitive paths used where no semantic alias exists.

bgHover._note: Dark override uses Figma primitive color/primitive/brand/stpatrick/800 (#20184b). Primitive now defined in repo as of DS V2.1.0 parity migration 2026-07-24.

focusRing._note: Used as border-color on :focus-visible. Box-shadow uses primitive.shadow.focusRing.*. Alpha values are fixed — same in light and dark.

linkButton._note: Link-style button variants. 'modifable' = white text on dark/colored backgrounds.

table._note: Data table leading column and header tokens.

selectField._note: Select Family — L3 namespaced tokens. Phase 1 2026-08-13. Supersedes pre-L3 flat tokens (kept in tokens.css for legacy compat). S-17 accepted: {ns}/border/hover → surface/brand/primary → semantic.color.brand.primary (#403297). S-04 accepted: icon/dissabled typo in Figma theme collection — CSS emits --color-icon-disabled (correct spelling). D-03 accepted: coin+exchange Open+Error use text/placeholder at component level.
selectField._legacy: Pre-L3 flat CSS vars (--select-*, --compact-select-*) kept in tokens.css for backwards compatibility. New Select components must consume the namespaced vars below.

country._note: select-country/* — 15 L3 vars. Identical aliases to basic.

coin._note: select-coin/* — 15 L3 vars. D-03 accepted: Open+Error states use text/placeholder at component level — implement as-designed.

exchange._note: select-exchange/* — 15 L3 vars. D-03 accepted: same Open+Error behavior as coin.

compact._note: compact-select/* — shared by ↳compact-select and ↳compact-select-for-input. 9 pre-L3 flat vars kept in CSS; icon/default + icon/disabled added Phase 1.

inline._note: inline-select/* — 11 L3 vars. No border, no background by design.

tabMenu._note: Horizontal and vertical tab menu tokens.

drawer._note: Drawer/side-panel tokens. Source: Design System Scalable V.2.1.0 ❖ Drawer. Sync: 2026-08-25.

checkbox._note: CSS impl: tokens.css --checkbox-* (light). Dark mode auto-flips via semantic cascade. Figma: ↳checkbox ComponentSet node 2113:34056, page ❖ Checkbox. L3 variable IDs 2609:4299–2609:4304, 3166:188. bg-hover aliases text/neutral/disabled (text token reused for bg fill — DS design choice). border.disabled emitted as reserved token — DS variable 2609:4303 exists but not assigned to a visible Figma layer; do NOT apply in component CSS until DS confirms binding.

checkboxLabel._note: CSS impl: tokens.css --checkbox-label-* (light). Dark mode auto-flips via semantic cascade. Figma: ↳checkbox-label ComponentSet node 2164:10056, page ❖ Checkbox. L3 variable IDs 2609:4295–2609:4298. bg emitted as --checkbox-label-bg; apply only if root frame carries a visible fill (pending DS Q4 confirmation).

checkboxCard._note: CSS impl: tokens.css --checkbox-card-* (light). Dark mode auto-flips via semantic cascade. Figma: ↳checkbox-card ComponentSet node 2166:660, page ❖ Checkbox. L3 variable IDs 3166:189–3166:199. Namespace rebounded from radio-card/* on 2026-07-30. DS gap: border.hover (3166:194) exists in DS but Hover card frames have no stroke — do NOT apply without DS confirmation. Card shadow (Default state) uses external library Effect Style; CSS var unresolved — pending DS owner confirmation.

switch._note: Base switch control tokens. DS v2.1.0 — Figma: switch/* namespace (VariableCollectionId:1902:2617). Switch naming applied 2026-08-03.

switchCard._note: Switch card container tokens. DS v2.1.0 — Figma: switch-card/* namespace. Phase 3A fix (2026-08-04): bgHover (bg/weak-50 via external 01-Tokens lib → neutral/25 = #f7f7f7) + borderActive (brand/primary = #403297) added. Deferred: badge/surface, badge/text, icon (L2 aliases unconfirmed — pending Figma variable inspection).

keyComponent._note: Label, hint, and password-strength sub-components. Paths follow semantic → component layering.

keyIcon._note: Icon badge colors. Each palette: icon = foreground, lighterBg = tinted background. Paths follow semantic → component layering; primitive paths used where no semantic alias exists.

inputText._note: Input text variant overrides. Only tokens that differ from the base InputText token set.

badge._note: Component color palette. References primitive.color.* directly — Badge uses its own color palette, not semantic aliases. 9 colors × 4 styles × 4 roles (bg, text, icon, stroke). Dark mode values invert the scale toward lighter stops.

dropdownItems._note: CSS impl: tokens.css --dropdown-items-* (light). Dark mode auto-flips via semantic cascade — no [data-theme="dark"] overrides needed. Figma: ↳dropdown-items ComponentSet node 2090:6272, page ❖ Dropdown. L3 variable IDs 3149:896–3149:913 (original 18) + 3337:1189–3337:1190 (icon/default + chevron/default added 2026-08-18 by DS Auditor — 20 total). DS gap G4: descriptions.default uses icon/sub (icon token, not a text token). DS gap G6: bg.hover and bg.selected alias the same semantic token (surface.soft) — confirmed design intent. Repo: direct L2 chevron binding replaced by --dropdown-items-chevron-default 2026-08-18.

subtext._note: Figma: dropdown-items/subtext/* → text/neutral/subtle. Emits as --color-text-subtle (semantic.color.text.subtle → prim-neutral-400). No dedicated --color-text-neutral-subtle alias in tokens.css.

descriptions._note: DS gap G4: dropdown-items/descriptions/default → icon/sub. Uses icon token, not a text token. Flag for DS review.

icon._note: Figma: dropdown-items/icon/default → icon/strong (VariableID:3337:1189). Added 2026-08-18 by DS Auditor. Basic left icon vectors (Globe, Small+Large, all 5 states) bound to this L3. State-invariant — no per-state icon tokens.

chevron._note: Figma: dropdown-items/chevron/default → brand/primary/base (VariableID:3337:1190). Added 2026-08-18 by DS Auditor. All 60 right chevron vectors bound to this L3. State-invariant — no per-state chevron tokens. DI-03: disabled state does not change chevron color (accepted DS gap).

dropdownList._note: CSS impl: tokens.css --dropdown-list-* (light). Dark mode auto-flips via semantic cascade. Figma: dropdown-list ComponentSet, page ❖ Dropdown. L3 variable IDs 3149:914–3149:915. Gap: border/neutral/soft has no dedicated alias in tokens.css; semantic.color.border.default is the closest emitted equivalent. Shadow: Figma Effect Style regular-shadow/medium → primitive.shadow.regular.medium.

border._note: Figma: dropdown-list/border/default → border/neutral/soft. No border.soft in semantic layer — using border.default as closest available equivalent.
